text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Goshiki Shuntaisai. 
A festival held only once every twelve 
years.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A special occasion to glimpse the 
intertwined history of humans 
and Umamusume, honoring the bonds between 
them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First comes the Sacred Flag Contest. 
Following that, the programs will proceed 
with the Soaring Gallop, 
Grand Mikoshi Haul, Yabusame, and Votive 
Dance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Participating are the sacred steed maidens 
governing each program and the contenders, 
as well as the chief sacred steed maiden 
who brought them all together— 
――<chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Do you have 
Lady <chrname>'s musubi-ita tablet?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Before the final Votive Dance commences, 
please hand it to her.
